name: count_freeze_location
description: REQ-765 / GH #3906. One frozen location of a count order in freeze mode: the order's roots and every location below them, taken once at the cut-off. count_order_id is a real foreign key onto count_order; org_unit_id is a copy of the header's, the scope column. A balance key is frozen when its org unit and location are a pair of an order whose freeze is in force.
